title: Apologizing
subtitle: ごめんなさい
review: Written by Claude. The Japanese and the romaji have not been checked by a Japanese speaker. English support only: no Burmese lines were written. Check before recording audio.

categories.desc: Four levels, from everyday to formal.
cards: Sumimasen.
I'm sorry. / Excuse me.

すみません。

The all-purpose polite sorry: bumping into someone, being a little late. Often said 'suimasen'.

Sumimasen, daijōbu desu ka.
すみません、大丈夫ですか。
I'm sorry, are you all right?
Gomen nasai.
I'm sorry.

ごめんなさい。

More personal than sumimasen: for people you know. To friends: Gomen.

Gomen nasai, wasuremashita.
ごめんなさい、忘れました。
I'm sorry, I forgot.
Mōshiwake arimasen.
I'm terribly sorry.

申し訳ありません。

Formal: at work, to customers. 'There is no excuse.'

Okurete mōshiwake arimasen.
遅れて申し訳ありません。
I'm terribly sorry for being late.
Shitsurei shimashita.
Pardon me.

失礼しました。

'I was rude.' For a small slip: a wrong number, stepping on a foot.

A, shitsurei shimashita.
あ、失礼しました。
Oh, pardon me.

categories.desc: Saying what you are sorry for.
cards: Osoku natte sumimasen.
Sorry I'm late.

遅くなってすみません。

The -te form of a verb + sumimasen: sorry for doing…

Osoku natte sumimasen. Densha ga okuremashita.
遅くなってすみません。電車が遅れました。
Sorry I'm late. The train was delayed.
Omatase shimashita.
Sorry to keep you waiting.

お待たせしました。

Said by staff bringing your order, and by anyone who arrives after you.

Omatase shimashita. Kōhī desu.
お待たせしました。コーヒーです。
Sorry for the wait. Here is your coffee.
Gomeiwaku o okake shimashita.
I'm sorry for the trouble.

ご迷惑をおかけしました。

Formal: you have caused someone inconvenience.

Kinō wa gomeiwaku o okake shimashita.
昨日はご迷惑をおかけしました。
I'm sorry for the trouble yesterday.
Machigaemashita.
I made a mistake.

間違えました。

Machigaeru: to get something wrong.

Sumimasen, heya o machigaemashita.
すみません、部屋を間違えました。
Sorry, I have the wrong room.

categories.desc: Putting the other person at ease.
cards: Daijōbu desu.
It's all right.

大丈夫です。

The usual reassuring answer. Careful: it can also mean 'no, thank you'.

Sumimasen! — Daijōbu desu yo.
すみません！— 大丈夫ですよ。
Sorry! — It's fine.
Ki ni shinaide kudasai.
Don't worry about it.

気にしないでください。

'Please don't let it bother you.'

Gomen nasai. — Ki ni shinaide kudasai.
ごめんなさい。— 気にしないでください。
I'm sorry. — Don't worry about it.
Ii desu yo.
That's OK.

いいですよ。

Light and friendly.

Okurete gomen nasai. — Ii desu yo.
遅れてごめんなさい。— いいですよ。
Sorry I'm late. — That's OK.
Kochira koso sumimasen.
I'm the one who should apologize.

こちらこそすみません。

Both sides apologize: very Japanese, and it ends the matter.

Sumimasen deshita. — Kochira koso sumimasen.
すみませんでした。— こちらこそすみません。
I'm sorry about that. — No, I'm the one who's sorry.
